result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed, but one promotional badge displays an obviously broken value: the discount pill on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '–0%'. No other visual defects were found; the clipped carousel item and the bottom card cut-off are expected scrolling behaviour.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' restaurant card (the pizza image) reads '–0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and suggests a missing or uncomputed discount value being rendered instead of the badge being hidden.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is zero, null or undefined, and make sure the real percentage is populated from the data (e.g. '–20%') before rendering.
